entities.summary: Kevin Vincent Frandsen is an American sports broadcaster and former professional baseball utility player. Frandsen played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Francisco Giants, Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim, Philadelphia Phillies, and Washington Nationals. He has provided television color commentary for the Nationals since the 2022 season.
